replicaCount.description: Number of replicas for the llama-server deployment

tag.description: Image tag; defaults to chart appVersion when empty

podSecurityContext.description: Security context applied at the Pod level

securityContext.description: Security context applied at the container level

port.description: Port exposed by the Kubernetes service

enabled.description: Enable TLS configuration for the ingress

secretName.description: Secret containing the TLS certificate and private key

nGpuLayers.description: Number of GPU layers to offload (0 = CPU only)

nCpuFfn.description: Keep dense FFN weights of the first N layers in the CPU (non-MoE counterpart of nCpuLayers)

alias.description: Model name alias exposed in the API (comma-separated, maps to LLAMA_ARG_ALIAS)

timeout.description: Server read/write timeout in seconds (maps to LLAMA_ARG_TIMEOUT, default: 600)

threadsHttp.description: Number of threads used to process HTTP requests (maps to LLAMA_ARG_THREADS_HTTP, default: -1)

nPredict.description: Number of tokens to predict (maps to LLAMA_ARG_N_PREDICT, default: -1, -1 = infinity)

perf.description: Enable internal libllama performance timings (maps to LLAMA_ARG_PERF, 1 to enable)

threads.description: Number of CPU threads to use for generation

mainGpu.description: Index of the GPU to use as main GPU

threadsBatch.description: Number of threads for batch / prompt processing (default: same as threads)

numa.description: NUMA optimization strategy: distribute, isolate, numactl

rpc.description: Comma-separated list of RPC servers (host:port) for distributed inference

hf.description: Hugging Face model repository (maps to LLAMA_ARG_HF_REPO)

model.description: Model path inside the container (maps to LLAMA_ARG_MODEL)

modelUrl.description: URL to download model from (direct download, maps to LLAMA_ARG_MODEL_URL)

hfFile.description: HuggingFace model filename / glob pattern to select a specific GGUF file (maps to LLAMA_ARG_HF_FILE)

mmproj.description: Path to a multimodal projector file (maps to LLAMA_ARG_MMPROJ)

mmprojUrl.description: URL to download multimodal projector from (maps to LLAMA_ARG_MMPROJ_URL)

mmprojAuto.description: Whether to use multimodal projector file if available, useful when using hf model (maps to LLAMA_ARG_MMPROJ_AUTO)

overrideTensor.description: Override tensor buffer type, e.g. ATTN=CPU (maps to LLAMA_ARG_OVERRIDE_TENSOR)

loadMode.description: Model loading mode (maps to LLAMA_ARG_LOAD_MODE, default: auto)

lazyMode.description: On-demand tensor reading per-layer: auto, 1, 0 (maps to LLAMA_ARG_LAZY_MODE, default: auto)

repack.description: Whether to enable weight repacking (maps to LLAMA_ARG_REPACK, default: enabled)

modelsDir.description: Directory to scan for GGUF model files, enables model listing endpoint (maps to LLAMA_ARG_MODELS_DIR)

modelsMax.description: Maximum number of models loaded simultaneously (maps to LLAMA_ARG_MODELS_MAX, default: 1)

modelsMemoryMargin.description: VRAM margin reserved for non-model use when auto-loading in MiB (maps to LLAMA_ARG_MODELS_MEMORY_MARGIN, default: 0)

modelsAutoload.description: Auto-load models on first request (maps to LLAMA_ARG_MODELS_AUTOLOAD, default: enabled)

dockerRepo.description: Docker Hub image repository used by the model router (maps to LLAMA_ARG_DOCKER_REPO)

tags.description: Model tags to attach, comma-separated (maps to LLAMA_ARG_TAGS)

mmprojOffload.description: Whether to offload the multimodal projector to GPU (maps to LLAMA_ARG_MMPROJ_OFFLOAD, default: enabled)

imageMaxTokens.description: Maximum number of image tokens to generate per image (maps to LLAMA_ARG_IMAGE_MAX_TOKENS, default: 0 = from model)

imageMinTokens.description: Minimum number of image tokens per image (maps to LLAMA_ARG_IMAGE_MIN_TOKENS, default: 0 = from model)

mtmdBatchMaxTokens.description: Maximum tokens in one multimodal batch (maps to LLAMA_ARG_MTMD_BATCH_MAX_TOKENS, default: 0 = unlimited)

context.description: Context window and KV cache memory settings

shift.description: Enable context-shift when context is full (maps to LLAMA_ARG_CONTEXT_SHIFT, 1 to enable)

cachePrompt.description: Enable KV cache reuse for identical prompt prefixes (maps to LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_PROMPT, 1 to enable)

cacheReuse.description: Minimum number of prefix tokens to reuse from the KV cache (maps to LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_REUSE, default: 0)

cacheIdleSlots.description: Maximum number of idle slots whose KV cache to keep in memory (maps to LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_IDLE_SLOTS, default: -1 = all)

kvUnifiedPerSlot.description: Unified KV cache size per slot in tokens, overrides context.size per slot (maps to LLAMA_ARG_KV_UNIFIED_PER_SLOT)

kvOffload.description: Whether to enable KV cache offloading to GPU (maps to LLAMA_ARG_KV_OFFLOAD, 1 to enable)

swaFull.description: Use full-size SWA (Sliding Window Attention) cache (maps to LLAMA_ARG_SWA_FULL, 1 to enable)

checkpoints.description: Whether to enable context-state checkpoints for recompute (maps to LLAMA_ARG_CTX_CHECKPOINTS, 1 to enable)

checkpointMinSpacingNt.description: Minimum token spacing between context checkpoints (maps to LLAMA_ARG_CHECKPOINT_MIN_SPACING_NT)

slotSavePath.description: Path to save/restore slot state (KV cache) for resume support (maps to LLAMA_ARG_SLOT_SAVE_PATH)

ropeScalingType.description: RoPE frequency scaling method (maps to LLAMA_ARG_ROPE_SCALING_TYPE, default: linear unless set by model)

ropeScale.description: RoPE context scaling factor, expands context by factor N (maps to LLAMA_ARG_ROPE_SCALE)

ropeFreqBase.description: RoPE base frequency for NTK-aware scaling (maps to LLAMA_ARG_ROPE_FREQ_BASE, default: from model)

ropeFreqScale.description: RoPE frequency scaling factor, expands context by 1/N (maps to LLAMA_ARG_ROPE_FREQ_SCALE)

yarnOrigCtx.description: YaRN: original context size of the model (maps to LLAMA_ARG_YARN_ORIG_CTX, default: 0 = training context)

yarnExtFactor.description: YaRN: extrapolation mix factor (maps to LLAMA_ARG_YARN_EXT_FACTOR, default: -1.00, 0 = full interpolation)

yarnAttnFactor.description: YaRN: scale sqrt(t) or attention magnitude (maps to LLAMA_ARG_YARN_ATTN_FACTOR, default: -1.00)

yarnBetaSlow.description: YaRN: high correction dim or alpha (maps to LLAMA_ARG_YARN_BETA_SLOW, default: -1.00)

yarnBetaFast.description: YaRN: low correction dim or beta (maps to LLAMA_ARG_YARN_BETA_FAST, default: -1.00)

fit.description: Control of fit in memory device

enabled.description: Auto-fit model to available VRAM (on or off, default: off)

fitCtx.description: Target context size when using fit (default: 0)

fitTarget.description: Target VRAM usage ratio when using fit (default: 0.90)

split.description: How to split the model across multiple GPUs

mode.description: Split mode: none = one GPU only, layer = split layers and KV (pipelined), row = split weights by rows (parallelized), tensor = split weights and KV (parallelized, EXPERIMENTAL)

tensor.description: Fraction of the model to offload to each GPU (comma-separated, e.g. '2.1,1')

device.description: Comma-separated list of GPU devices to use for offloading

cacheType.description: KV cache quantization types for keys and values

key.description: KV cache quantization type for keys (e.g. f16, q8_0, q4_0)

value.description: KV cache quantization type for values (e.g. f16, q8_0, q4_0)

cacheRam.description: Amount of KV cache to keep in CPU RAM in MiB

draftModel.description: Path to the draft model for speculative decoding

draftHfRepo.description: HuggingFace repo for the draft model (e.g. USER/MODEL[:Q])

draftNgl.description: Number of draft model layers to store in VRAM (default: auto)

draftNMin.description: Minimum number of draft tokens to use (default: 0)

draftNMax.description: Maximum number of draft tokens to generate

draftNUbatch.description: Physical max batch size for the draft context (default: 0 = same as --ubatch)

draftSampling.description: How the draft is sampled (default: greedy)

draftBackendSampling.description: Offload draft token sampling to the backend (1 = enable, 0 = disabled, default: 1)

draftCpuMoe.description: Keep all MoE weights in CPU for the draft model (1 = enable, 0 = disabled)

draftNCpuMoe.description: Keep MoE weights of first N layers in CPU for the draft model

synthLen.description: Target mean synthetic acceptance length (benchmarking only)

synthRates.description: Per-position synthetic acceptance probabilities, comma-separated (benchmarking only)

cacheType.description: KV cache quantization types for the draft model

key.description: KV cache quantization type for keys (e.g. f16, q8_0, q4_0)

value.description: KV cache quantization type for values (e.g. f16, q8_0, q4_0)

repeatPenalty.description: Control the repetition of token sequences in the generated text (maps to LLAMA_ARG_REPEAT_PENALTY)

presencePenalty.description: Repeat alpha presence penalty (maps to LLAMA_ARG_PRESENCE_PENALTY)

frequencyPenalty.description: Repeat alpha frequency penalty (maps to LLAMA_ARG_FREQUENCY_PENALTY)

enabled.description: Toggle reasoning features (maps to LLAMA_ARG_REASONING, on, off, auto)

format.description: Reasoning format / thought extraction (maps to LLAMA_ARG_THINK, e.g. auto, deepseek, deepseek-legacy, none)

effort.description: Reasoning effort level (maps to LLAMA_ARG_REASONING_EFFORT, e.g. default, low, medium, high)

budget.description: Thinking token budget (maps to LLAMA_ARG_THINK_BUDGET, -1 = unrestricted, 0 = disabled, >0 = limit)

budgetMessage.description: Message to inject when thinking budget is exceeded (maps to LLAMA_ARG_THINK_BUDGET_MESSAGE)

preserve.description: Preserve reasoning tokens in output (maps to LLAMA_ARG_REASONING_PRESERVE, 1 to enable)

moe.description: Mixture of Experts (MoE) configuration for models such as DeepSeek or Qwen MoE

cpuOffload.description: Keep all MoE feed-forward weights in CPU RAM instead of VRAM (maps to LLAMA_ARG_CPU_MOE, 1 to enable)

nCpuLayers.description: Keep MoE weights of the first N layers in CPU RAM (maps to LLAMA_ARG_N_CPU_MOE)

cacheMib.description: GPU cache size in MiB dedicated to frequently used MoE experts (maps to LLAMA_ARG_MOE_CACHE_MIB, default 0 = disabled)

cacheCpuShare.description: Share/ratio for MoE cache misses handled via CPU memory (maps to LLAMA_ARG_MOE_CACHE_CPU_SHARE, float between 0 and 1)

enabled.description: Enable embedding mode and endpoints (maps to LLAMA_ARG_EMBEDDINGS)

pooling.description: Pooling type for embeddings (maps to LLAMA_ARG_POOLING, e.g. none, mean, cls, last, rank)

kvUnified.description: Enable unified KV cache across sequences (1 to enable)

enabled.description: Whether to enable the Web UI (1 = enable, 0 = disabled, maps to LLAMA_ARG_UI)

uiConfig.description: Inline JSON string of default Web UI preferences (maps to LLAMA_ARG_UI_CONFIG)

uiConfigFile.description: Path to a JSON file of default Web UI preferences (maps to LLAMA_ARG_UI_CONFIG_FILE)

mcpProxy.description: Expose an MCP proxy endpoint in the Web UI (maps to LLAMA_ARG_UI_MCP_PROXY, 1 to enable, 0 = disabled)

staticPath.description: Path to serve static files from (Web UI assets, maps to LLAMA_ARG_STATIC_PATH)

serversConfigFile.description: Path to MCP servers JSON config file (maps to LLAMA_ARG_MCP_SERVERS_CONFIG)

serversJson.description: Inline JSON string describing MCP servers to connect to (maps to LLAMA_ARG_MCP_SERVERS_JSON)

apiKeyFile.description: File containing API keys for authentication (one per line, maps to LLAMA_ARG_API_KEY_FILE)

apiPrefix.description: Prefix path the server serves from, without trailing slash (maps to LLAMA_ARG_API_PREFIX)

connect.description: Connect to a remote llama.cpp server instead of running locally (HOST:PORT, maps to LLAMA_ARG_CONNECT)

sslCertFile.description: Path to the PEM-encoded TLS certificate file (maps to LLAMA_ARG_SSL_CERT_FILE)

sslKeyFile.description: Path to the PEM-encoded TLS private key file (maps to LLAMA_ARG_SSL_KEY_FILE)

corsOrigins.description: Allowed CORS origins, comma-separated (default: *, maps to LLAMA_ARG_CORS_ORIGINS)

corsCredentials.description: Whether to allow CORS credentials (maps to LLAMA_ARG_CORS_CREDENTIALS, 1 to enable, 0 = disabled)

reusePort.description: Enable SO_REUSEPORT so multiple instances can bind the same port (maps to LLAMA_ARG_REUSE_PORT, 1 to enable)

noHost.description: Bypass host buffer, allowing extra buffers to be used (maps to LLAMA_ARG_NO_HOST, 1 to enable)

ssePingInterval.description: Interval between SSE keep-alive pings in seconds (maps to LLAMA_ARG_SSE_PING_INTERVAL, default: 15)

offline.description: Disable any network access such as HF downloads or model router (maps to LLAMA_ARG_OFFLINE, 1 to enable)

verbosity.description: Log verbosity level: -1 = error, 0 = info (default), 1 = debug, 2 = trace (maps to LLAMA_ARG_LOG_VERBOSITY)

file.description: Path to write log output to a file (maps to LLAMA_ARG_LOG_FILE)

jsonl.description: Output logs in JSONL format (maps to LLAMA_ARG_LOG_JSONL, 1 to enable, 0 = disabled)

colors.description: Use ANSI colors in log output (maps to LLAMA_ARG_LOG_COLORS, 1 to enable, 0 = disabled)

prefix.description: Add a module/function prefix to log lines (maps to LLAMA_ARG_LOG_PREFIX, 1 to enable, 0 = disabled)

timestamps.description: Add timestamps to log lines (maps to LLAMA_ARG_LOG_TIMESTAMPS, 1 to enable, 0 = disabled)

metrics.description: Enable or disable the /metrics (Prometheus) endpoint (maps to LLAMA_ARG_ENDPOINT_METRICS, 1 to enable, 0 = disabled)

slots.description: Enable or disable the /slots endpoint (maps to LLAMA_ARG_ENDPOINT_SLOTS, 1 to enable, 0 = disabled)

props.description: Enable or disable the /props endpoint (maps to LLAMA_ARG_ENDPOINT_PROPS, 1 to enable, 0 = disabled)

reranking.description: Enable the /rerank endpoint for cross-encoder reranking (maps to LLAMA_ARG_RERANKING, 1 to enable)

chatTemplate.description: Custom Jinja2 chat template string (maps to LLAMA_ARG_CHAT_TEMPLATE)

chatTemplateFile.description: Path to a file containing a custom Jinja2 chat template (maps to LLAMA_ARG_CHAT_TEMPLATE_FILE)

chatTemplateKwargs.description: Extra key=value pairs passed to the Jinja2 template renderer (maps to LLAMA_ARG_CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS)

jinja.description: Whether to use the Jinja2 template engine for chat (maps to LLAMA_ARG_JINJA, 1 to enable, 0 = disabled)

skipChatParsing.description: Force pure content parser, disables reasoning/tool extraction (maps to LLAMA_ARG_SKIP_CHAT_PARSING, 1 to enable, 0 = disabled)

prefillAssistant.description: Whether to prefill assistant response from last assistant message (maps to LLAMA_ARG_PREFILL_ASSISTANT, 1 to enable, 0 = disabled)

tools.description: Comma-separated list of tool names or JSON tool definitions to expose (maps to LLAMA_ARG_TOOLS)

toolsRuntime.description: Tool calling runtime (e.g. native, python; maps to LLAMA_ARG_TOOLS_RUNTIME)

agent.description: Agentic loop configuration (tool use automation; maps to LLAMA_ARG_AGENT)

ffmpegDir.description: Path to ffmpeg binaries for video frame extraction (maps to LLAMA_ARG_VIDEO_FFMPEG_DIR)

fps.description: Frames per second to extract from video inputs (maps to LLAMA_ARG_VIDEO_FPS)

timestampInterval.description: Interval in seconds between frame timestamps in prompts (maps to LLAMA_ARG_VIDEO_TIMESTAMP_INTERVAL)

extraEnv.description: Additional arbitrary env vars to inject (key: value map)

enabled.description: Enable a PersistentVolumeClaim to store model files

storageClass.description: StorageClass name; leave empty to use the cluster default

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the llama-server container

runtimeClassName.description: RuntimeClassName for the pod (defaults to 'nvidia' if gpu.vendor is nvidia)

gpu.description: GPU resource allocation. When set, adds vendor-specific GPU limits/requests to the container.
